about: Notification texts as the backend stores them (and stored them: the retired wordings) and as they read in Bahasa Melayu and Simplified Chinese. serverMessageRows/notifications.test.ts checks localizeNotificationMessage against them: fixed rows, spacing, case and a final full stop, values kept exactly (Chinese, $1, braces, line breaks), values in another order, the more specific template, a live session's start, and text without a row.
